title: Caspase-8 Mutation Promotes HNSCC Development and Resistance to Anti–PD-1
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Ahead of Print.
Heterozygous mutations of the gene encoding caspase-8 protease occur in 10% of human head and neck squamous cell carcinomas (HNSCCs). Cell line studies indicate that these mutations block apoptosis induced by death ligands. However, thein vivorole of ...
